json.take: It is easy to demand the extra pass from the studio, but without any simulation data to prove a clean passing lane exists, we are just guessing at shadows. When a forward has a clear sight of goal in transition, Oren Novacek is right to trust his instincts and shoot rather than force a hypothetical pass.
